{{Top}}
A '''tutor droid''' was a model of [[Droid/Legends|droid]]. It was designed to offer quality education in the place of a [[Teacher/Legends|teacher]], and was often cheaper than the biological alternative. [[Industrial Automaton/Legends|Industrial Automaton]] produced a line of tutor droids including the [[TTS-15 Series Tutorial Droid]].
